rows.ARS:
Orange blend Floribunda.
Registration name: Guitare ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jean-Marie Gaujard (1903-1995) (France, before 1963).
Introduced in France by Jean-Marie Gaujard in 1963 as 'Guitare'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink, golden-yellow reverse. Colorful mixture of gold and orange, with coral-red shading towards the petal margins. Strong fragrance. Medium, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, rounded bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit: Medium, bushy. Light green, leathery foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Protect tender new spring growth from hard freezes that may cause canker, die-back and death of the plant. . Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood..

colour: Orange-pink, golden-yellow reverse. Colorful mixture of gold and orange, with coral-red shading towards the petal margins.
